scope: Independent read-only N5 integration correctness review. Frozen production inputs and pinned local SDK. Runtime/UI tests may still be changing; no hardware, scheduler, target ABI or live RF proof. No production or index edits.

findings.title: Invalidate prior AP timer status when the post-save refresh fails
findings.scenario: Boot desired AP timeout is 0 and the UI shows automatic restart disabled. Save timeout=1 (or another nonzero value), POST succeeds durably, then its forced GET fails. The catch changes only network-settings-status; network-timeout-status continues to claim automatic restart is disabled even though the owner can arm and restart. The reverse transition can retain an old active countdown.
findings.requested_change: For the matching request epoch, clear or replace the separate timer label with an unavailable/pending status in this catch, and add an actual page-script regression for a successful timeout change followed by failed refresh.
findings.status: resolved in final frozen source; independent original reproduction now passes

limitations: Read-only code/SDK review and actual page-script seams are not physical CYD, RF/DHCP, live reset, OTA-flash durability or target ABI evidence.
SDK event/config/lifecycle changes arriving after the documented final application check cannot be made atomic with esp_restart by this API.
Did not rerun the runtime/HTTP/production GCC/Clang suites as part of this independent review; implementation agents and parent own those gates.
Pinned sources were reviewed at recorded hashes; any later production changes require another delta review.
